Description: Logarithmic plot of  vs. time for a 65  binary (e.g., GW150914), error bars .

Glossary
: Scalar field, quantized mediator of fluid dynamics.
: Strong coupling (~1), governs quark interactions.
: Weak coupling (~0.65), drives electroweak processes.
: Scalar GW strain (~10^{-22}), quantum fluid signature.
: Clustering coefficient (~0.019), derived from weak-gravity coupling.
